title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants. Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós:

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


Nosso Cliente:

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional no segmento de petróleo e gás.


Estamos buscando um(a) Big Data Engineer para fazer parte da nossa equipe. Nesta posição, você irá desenvolver e suportar pipelines de dados escaláveis e soluções inovadoras em ambientes híbridos, utilizando tecnologias como Hadoop, Spark, Azure e Snowflake. Se você gosta de trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados e quer contribuir para projetos de impacto global na área de energia e sustentabilidade, essa oportunidade é para você!


Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis utilizando Apache Hadoop, Spark e Kafka
  • Implementar processos de ETL e integração de dados de múltiplas fontes (internas e externas)
  • Trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados estruturados e não estruturados para habilitar análises em escala
  • Otimizar e ajustar jobs Spark e Hadoop para melhor performance
  • Atuar com CDP (Cloudera Data Platform) para deploy e gerenciamento de aplicações Big Data
  • Integrar soluções com Azure, Snowflake e infraestrutura on-premises
  • Colaborar com cientistas de dados, analistas, arquitetos e stakeholders para entender requisitos e entregar soluções robustas
  • Utilizar ferramentas de versionamento como GitHub e automações via GitHub Actions e/ou Azure DevOps
  • Explorar e implementar novas tecnologias de acordo com o roadmap interno de Big Data
  • Garantir segurança, integridade e governança dos dados

title: GIS Python Developer
description:
GIS Python Developer (QA/QC Automation – ArcGIS Workflow Manager)

Location: 100% Remote

Type: Full-Time / Contract

About the Role

We are looking for a GIS Python Developer to design, develop, and implement automated Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) processes for spatial data. The role involves writing Python scripts (primarily using ArcPy or the ArcGIS API for Python ) and integrating them into Esri’s ArcGIS Workflow Manager to streamline and automate GIS data validation across teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop QA/QC Scripts:
  • Create and maintain Python scripts to automatically identify and correct spatial data issues such as:
  • Missing or invalid geometry
  • Polygon overlaps or gaps
  • Attribute inconsistencies
  • Coordinate system mismatches
  • Topology and connectivity errors (e.g., roads not connecting properly)


  • Integrate with ArcGIS Workflow Manager:
  • Configure and embed QA/QC scripts as automated steps within ArcGIS Workflow Manager task sequences, enabling:
  • Automatic validation after data edits or updates
  • Flagging and reporting of errors for correction
  • Consistent enforcement of spatial data quality standards


  • Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance:
  • Maintain accuracy, consistency, and traceability of all GIS data edits and updates across the enterprise environment.


  • Collaborate Across Teams:
  • Work closely with GIS analysts, database administrators, and developers to ensure smooth integration, performance optimization, and scalability of QA/QC solutions.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Computer Science, Geomatics , or a related field.
  • Proven experience in Python scripting for GIS automation .
  • Strong knowledge of Esri technologies , including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise , and ArcGIS Workflow Manager .
  • Experience with ArcPy and/or the ArcGIS API for Python .
  • Understanding of spatial data models, topology rules, and coordinate systems .
  • Familiarity with data quality management principles (QA/QC) in GIS environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with versioned geodatabases (ArcSDE) and enterprise data workflows.
  • Exposure to SQL and spatial database management.
  • Knowledge of automation frameworks or DevOps practices within GIS.


What You’ll Achieve

You’ll play a key role in building a repeatable, automated, and auditable quality-control process for spatial data—ensuring every dataset and map product meets enterprise accuracy standards before publication or approval.

Colombo & Hurd, PL is a nationally recognized boutique immigration law firm dedicated to representing professionals, investors, businesses, and families from across Latin America and around the world. Since our founding in 2006, we’ve grown to a global team of over 350, including more than 30 U.S.-based immigration attorneys.

Your expertise will be instrumental in guiding high potential individuals and businesses through the intricate U.S. immigration landscape. A successful candidate will have excellent writing, research and analytical skills to assume responsibility in an active and diverse immigration practice. The applicant must be fully bilingual in both English and Portuguese.


This role requires excellent communication skills both via email and orally. It is exceptionally important that we communicate with our clients in both a timely and effective manner.

  • Strategic Case Analysis: Dive deep into complex EB-2 National Interest Waiver and EB-1 Immigrant Visa cases, identifying opportunities and potential challenges.

  • Client Collaboration: Build strong relationships with clients, providing clear and concise information and solicitation of documentation throughout the immigration process.
  • Global Teamwork: Collaborate seamlessly with a diverse team of legal professionals across the globe to achieve optimal outcomes.


Qualifications:


  • Licensed Lawyer in Brazil
  • 3+ years of legal experience (preferred, not required)
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong research and analytical abilities
  • Meticulous attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • A passion for immigration law and a desire to make a positive impact

We seek professionals who embody our core values of Integrity, Excellence, Teamwork, Hard Work, and Open Communication.


Ready to Make Your Mark?

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior "980883"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Estruturar e manter os processos de ingestão de dados de múltiplos serviços, sistemas e fontes externas da plataforma focando em alta performance e qualidade dos dados;
  • Entender profundamente a plataforma técnica para identificar novas fontes e evoluções necessárias, com suporte do time de tecnologia;
  • Você será a "Força" do time de Engenharia de Dados dentro dos squads de tecnologia e deve ser capaz de entregar de ponta a ponta as demandas específicas, alinhando processos, dependências e suporte com o time do CoE de Dados;
  • Criação e sustentação de pipelines de integração dos dados do ambiente de produção por CDC;
  • Otimização do processamento dos dados para alta disponibilidade;
  • Soluções de integração de dados externos (parceiros e outros sistemas), via API, FTP ou consumo direto de flat files;
  • Orquestração de todas as dependências (pré e pós) e garantida de entrega;
  • Mapeamento de evolução da plataforma de dados e adequação a novas implementações técnicas;
  • Manutenção de Estruturas de Dados para consumo específico, como Data Marts e Feature Stores;
  • Implementação das regras globais de arquitetura e governança de dados.

O que você precisa ter

  • Big Data | Tecnologias, Soluções e Conceitos como Spark, Hadoop, Hive, MapReduce, Kafka;
  • Cloud Computing | Azure, AWS, GCP;
  • Workflow | Control-M e/ou AirFlow;
  • Storage Solutions | Redshift, Parquet, Delta;
  • Estatística | Análise Descritiva, probabilidade, inferência, bootstrapping, testes de hipótese, regressão;
  • Data Modeling | Landing, Cleaning, Processing, Curation, Estruturas de Fato/Dimensão, encadeamento de ETLs, Data Marts;
  • Lógica de Programação | Escrever e revisar queries em banco de dados, usar parâmetros, criar variáveis;
  • SQL | Porque dado em planilha é coisa do passado;
  • Dremio, Looker, Metabase ou outras plataformas de Self-Service de dados | Para se colocar sempre no lugar do cliente;
  • Python ou R | Para quando a coisa fica bem séria;
  • Scala & Spark | Trabalhar com grande volume de dados sempre pode ser mais rápido;
  • Inglês | Nossa expansão de operação tem vários países no planejamento.

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

Regime de Contratação

CLT.

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Espanhol | Nossos times globais estão baseados em Madrid.

O(a) profissional será uma peça-chave na evolução das nossas soluções enterprise application , com foco em performance, escalabilidade, segurança e observabilidade . Procuramos alguém que pense como arquiteto, desenvolva como engenheiro e apoie o crescimento técnico do time.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Requisitos e qualificações


  • +7 anos de experiência com .NET / .NET Core / C# em aplicações corporativas.
  • Experiência comprovada em Azure Cloud , incluindo AKS, Storage e Networking.
  • Experiência prática com Kubernetes , Docker , Helm e NGINX ingress controllers .
  • Domínio de SQL Server e PostgreSQL (incluindo tunning, índices, queries complexas, MER).
  • Experiência com RabbitMQ e mensageria distribuída.
  • Vivência em pipelines as code (YAML pipelines no Azure DevOps ou GitHub Actions).
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade e monitoramento (ELK, Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Entendimento de autenticação/autorização moderna (JWT, OAuth2, OpenID).
  • Prática com arquitetura limpa, DDD, SOLID, CQRS e boas práticas de engenharia.


Diferenciais (que farão você se destacar)

  • Experiência com StackGres , Redis/Dragonfly , Elastic Cloud ou Azure Monitor/Log Analytics .
  • Experiência com infraestrutura como código (Terraform Modules e GitOps).
  • Participação em projetos de alta performance e observabilidade distribuída .
  • Perfil colaborativo, capaz de mentorar outros desenvolvedores e influenciar boas práticas de engenharia.
  • Mentalidade de engenheiro de produto — orientado a resultado e impacto no negócio.

O que valorizamos

  • Mentalidade cloud-first e curiosidade por novas tecnologias.
  • Visão arquitetural e pensamento sistêmico.
  • Cultura DevOps e senso de ownership.
  • Comunicação técnica clara e proatividade na resolução de problemas complexos.



Informações adicionais

O que a Aliare proporciona?!

Um time integrado e preparado para novos desafios, que atua com credibilidade e transparência, com objetivo de evoluirmos de forma contínua para facilitar o trabalho de quem alimenta o mundo. Priorizando sempre em nossas ações a ética, o relacionamento, a realização, o comprometimento e inovação.

We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.



Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
  • Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
  • Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
  • Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
  • A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.


The successful candidate will…

  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?

Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Jira Architect
description:
Senior CMDB & Automation Engineer (Contractor – PJ)

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Engagement Type: Short-term project (flexible dedication)


About the Opportunity

Our client is looking for a Senior CMDB & Automation Engineer to lead a high-impact project focused on the strategic redesign and implementation of a Configuration Management Database (CMDB) within the Jira Service Management (JSM) ecosystem.

This project requires a hands-on technical consultant capable of architecting the future state of the configuration management practice, enhancing operational stability, and reinforcing the organization’s security posture. The consultant will deliver a sustainable, automated, and high-integrity CMDB that provides real-time, accurate data visibility.


Scope of Work

This engagement follows a structured, deliverable-based approach divided into key project phases:

Phase 1: CMDB Audit & Maturity Assessment

  • Conduct a comprehensive diagnostic of the existing JSM Assets environment to establish a baseline.
  • Identify data quality issues, architectural limitations, and process gaps.
  • Engage with key stakeholders (application owners, infrastructure, and security teams) to define essential CMDB use cases.

Phase 2: Future-State Architecture & Governance Design

  • Architect a scalable, service-centric CMDB model and taxonomy within JSM Assets.
  • Design and document a Governance Framework defining data ownership, roles, responsibilities, and change control processes.
  • Define a data federation strategy to distinguish mastered versus federated data sources.

Phase 3: Implementation & Integration

  • Execute the approved CMDB architecture within JSM, including schema and automation rule configuration.
  • Engineer and implement automated, bi-directional integrations between the CMDB and key systems (e.g., Okta, Kandji, Intune) using the enterprise iPaaS.
  • Review and migrate existing Okta Workflows into the iPaaS for improved governance and scalability.

Phase 4: Enablement & Handover

  • Develop comprehensive documentation for integrations, data models, and governance processes.
  • Build Jira dashboards to provide visibility into CMDB health and accuracy.
  • Ensure the designed solution is fully documented and ready for transition to the client’s internal IT team.


Qualifications

Required Experience

  • Minimum 8+ years in IT Infrastructure or related fields, with at least 4 years focused on CMDB architecture, design, and governance.
  • Advanced, hands-on expertise with Jira Service Management (Assets) , including schema architecture, imports, and complex IQL configuration.
  • Proven experience leading end-to-end CMDB implementation or redesign projects as the primary technical architect.
  • Solid understanding of ITIL principles, particularly Service Asset and Configuration Management (SACM).
  • Demonstrated experience integrating external data sources into CMDB via REST APIs and iPaaS platforms.


Preferred Experience

  • Prior experience with other ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
  • Scripting skills (Python, Groovy, or similar).
  • Professional certifications such as Atlassian ACP-JSM or ITIL v4.
  • Background in fast-paced, cloud-native, or cybersecurity environments.


Why This Project?

This is a high-visibility consulting engagement where your work will directly influence the client’s operational maturity and IT best practices. The consultant will have autonomy and ownership to design and deliver a foundational data architecture that enhances scalability, security, and reliability across the organization.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

  • Solid understanding of CI/CD concepts , including hands-on experience with GitHub Actions or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Pulumi , Terraform , or similar frameworks.
  • Experience building and managing containers (Docker) and working with container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes).
  • Strong understanding of software design principles , clean code , and best engineering practices .
  • Excellent communication skills in English and ability to work collaboratively in distributed, cross-functional teams.


Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have):

title: Instructional Designer
description:
ADP is hiring a Learning Design Consultant (Instructional Designer).


In this role, you will focus primarily on applying efficient and agile design approaches to develop innovative, engaging learning solutions, using ADP learning design standards and tools, to meet the learning needs of ADP associates and clients.


No two days are the same. You will do everything from creating design documents, testing and deploying content, conducting needs assessments across multiple business lines, establishing training plans, overseeing translations, measuring results, and more. You will do this all to the highest standards with an eye on appealing to multi-generational talent and the modern learner and by partnering across the learning organization to apply innovative techniques in instructional design. You can create compelling content and convey ideas and information to many levels of an organization.


To thrive in the role, you have 3+ years of experience in the learning - development field. You have worked independently to design and develop sound training in various modalities, i.e., eLearning, instructor-led, blended, job aids, and more, and can manage simultaneous projects with deadlines. It would be best to be a continuous learner who focuses on personal development and business process improvement to our design standards. Your work will help our businesses support our clients who employ one to millions of employees.


Like what you see? Apply now!


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Innovation : You seek opportunities to apply innovative design thinking to your projects and will work to keep ADP's approach to designing learning up to date with the products and solutions ADP offers its clients.
  • Flexibility and Agility : You can adapt to changing business requirements, projects, and resources and use agile approaches to meet business needs.
  • Design: You'll design holistic solutions engaging team members and business partners in the design process to ensure the solution design is flexible and addresses the unique needs of the learners. Solution design should consider and factor in how the work environment impacts learning.
  • Development: You can develop solutions across a broad set of learning modalities and tools without creating redundant solutions and ensure that continuous learning and performance support concepts are applied.
  • Learning Outcomes: You measure your outcomes and ensure your learning solutions result in the intended business impact.
  • Continuous Learner: You focus on personal development to develop and elevate professional knowledge and skill. You take the same approach to business process improvement to improve ADP learning design standards and drive the adoption of those standards. You maintain an outside-in perspective by building and maintaining peer networks inside and outside ADP.


TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

A college degree is not required but could set you apart. What's more important is having the skills and experience to do the job. You will need 3+ years of experience in instructional development, adult learning theory, and/or technical writing.

Other things that will set you apart:

  • Experience using eLearning tools such as Captivate, Articulate 360 , Synthesia, TechSmith Camtasia , TechSmith SnagIt, Audacity, and Vyond. Technical aptitude to quickly learn new development tools.
  • Experience using a Learning Management System (i.e., Litmos)
  • Experience with simple Graphic Design


Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in the learning and development field
  • Ability to systematically design, develop, and implement learning content that meets specific organizational needs
  • Skilled in building learning solutions for English-speaking audiences
  • Proficient in Articulate Storyline, Rise, Synthesia, or similar authoring tools
  • Working knowledge of Learning Management Systems (upload/manage content, apply technical standards, etc.)
  • Proven success collaborating virtually


YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Collaborate. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and respect one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner - doer. Mission-driven and committed to navigating change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.


Learn more here:

What are you waiting for? Apply now!

Se você tem perfil analítico, curiosidade para explorar novas fronteiras da ciência e vontade de gerar impacto real no futuro da beleza, que desejam cocriar conosco o amanhã da beleza.

Essa vaga afirmativa é para talentos diversos — Pessoa com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras (pretas e pardas), Pessoas 45+, Comunidade LGBTQI+ e Mulheres (Cis e Trans).

title: Azure Platform Engineer/ Architect
description:
Role Overview :


We are is seeking a hands-on Azure Platform Engineer/Architect with strong architectural knowledge of Azure PaaS services and DevOps skills. This person will work closely with backend engineers and automation teams to design, implement, and deploy cloud-native solutions on Azure. The role requires expertise in Azure services, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD pipelines, with the ability to troubleshoot and support PaaS solutions end-to-end.

Key Responsibilities :

  • Collaborate with backend engineers to architect and deploy Azure PaaS solutions, including Azure Functions, App Services, AKS, ACR, APIM, and Application Gateway.
  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps (YAML-based pipelines) or GitHub Actions when required.
  • Develop Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates, with the ability to deploy infrastructure manually if needed.
  • Provide hands-on troubleshooting of Azure environments, including debugging deployments, managing permissions (RBAC), and resolving issues with PaaS services.
  • Assist data scientists and AI engineers with containerization, API endpoints, and prototyping on Azure Machine Learning or related services.
  • Implement and enforce security gates (SonarQube, SCA, DAST, SAST) in CI/CD pipelines and ensure compliance with Azure policies and governance.
  • Optimize and monitor Azure environments using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
  • Support and improve operational automation (PowerShell, Python) and cost optimization initiatives (tagging, right-sizing).
  • Collaborate with teams to build solutions that run entirely on Azure PaaS, ensuring performance and scalability.

Required Skills :

  • Strong experience with Azure Functions, App Services, AKS, ACR, and APIM.
  • Hands-on expertise with Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates.
  • Proficiency in Azure DevOps Services (Repos, Pipelines, Boards, Artifacts) and/or GitHub Actions.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills for Azure PaaS services and deployment issues.
  • Experience with blue-green, canary, and rolling deployment strategies.
  • Knowledge of security and compliance practices in Azure (Azure Policy, RBAC, Key Vault, Defender for Cloud).
  • Proficiency in PowerShell, Python, or Bash for automation.
  • Familiarity with Azure cost management and resource optimization.
  • Excellent communication skills to guide and support development and data science teams.

title: Lead SRE Engineer
description:
About the Company:

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


About the Role

We’re seeking an experienced Lead Site Reliability Engineer to join our growing team in Brazil. In this role, you’ll partner with product teams to tackle critical infrastructure challenges, acting as both a hands-on technical expert and a mentor.

You’ll help design, build, and operate cloud platforms while driving reliability, performance, and security across the engineering organization.


Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Guide and support engineers, foster technical excellence through code reviews and design discussions, and help unblock complex challenges.
  • Documentation & Standards: Create and maintain runbooks, standards, and best-practice guides to strengthen operational capabilities.
  • Infrastructure as Code & CI/CD: Automate provisioning and deployments using Terraform and best-practice pipelines (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, etc.).
  • Reliability Engineering: Define SLIs/SLOs, manage error budgets, and build dashboards and alerts to proactively monitor system health.
  • Security & Compliance: Enforce least-privilege IAM policies, automate vulnerability scans, and maintain audit logging.
  • Monitoring & Observability: Instrument services with metrics, logs, and distributed tracing to enable rapid troubleshooting.
  • Cost Optimization: Implement tagging strategies, right-size resources, and use data-driven insights to manage cloud spend effectively.


Must Have

  • Managing production-critical systems with deep knowledge of SRE and DevOps principles .
  • Proven experience mentoring engineers and leading technical projects.
  • Strong proficiency with AWS and cloud-native best practices.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS or GKE) and large-scale container orchestration.
  • Expertise with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning.
  • Experience managing and debugging Redis and Postgres databases.
  • Solid understanding of VPCs, VPNs, load balancers, and cloud networking .
  • Proficiency with Git , branching strategies, and CI/CD integrations.
  • Strong grasp of web and network protocols (HTTP, REST, TLS, DNS, etc.).


Nice to Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience breaking down large, ambiguous projects into actionable tasks.
  • Familiarity with ArgoCD , GitHub Actions , Jenkins , or similar CI/CD tools.
  • Working knowledge of Python , Golang , and Helm .
  • Experience running scalable Node.js microservices.
  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure security and Terragrunt best practices.
  • Background in production readiness and high-growth engineering environments .


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Cloud Data Engineer
description:

Salary range: Competitive and negotiable based on experience

The Senior Cloud Data Engineer leads the design, architecture, and implementation of secure, scalable data solutions on AWS, utilizing Snowflake, dbt, and modern automation tools. This role drives best practices for data quality, validation, and governance, while optimizing performance and reliability across both cloud and legacy platforms. The Senior Cloud Data Engineer collaborates closely with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into robust data pipelines and products, mentor junior engineers, and champions continuous improvement in engineering standards and operational excellence.


Key Responsibilities

  • Leads the design, development, and maintenance of highly scalable, secure, and resilient data pipelines and systems on cloud platforms.

  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, business analysts, product owners, and application engineers—to understand and deliver on evolving data requirements.

  • Proactively identifies, investigates, and resolves data-related issues, providing technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior team members.
  • Champions continuous improvement by staying current with industry trends, emerging technologies, best practices, and by driving innovation in data engineering processes and solutions.
  • Partners with enterprise architecture and data governance teams to define and enforce data standards and compliance requirements.
  • Leads design reviews and technical workshops to uplevel engineering practices across the organization.
  • Contributes to strategic planning for data platform evolution and modernization initiatives.

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL , with hands-on experience in both relational (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, Snowflake) and NoSQL (e.g., MongoDB, DynamoDB) databases.
  • Extensive experience architecting and operating data platforms on AWS and Azure; relevant cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Data Analytics, Azure Data Engineer Associate) strongly preferred.

title: Médico Endocrinologista (RQE)
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia ;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:

REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.

Wunderdogs is an independent creative agency based in San Francisco, California with a growing distributed team across the U.S., Canada and Europe. We provide beginning-to-end design, production and strategy services to forward-thinking brands in the technology space, from startups to established companies.

From one-off-digital projects to full website designs, no two Wunderdogs jobs are the same: if you’re a creative who enjoys variety in what you do the diverse nature of our work is sure to keep you on your toes. We’re looking for a designer excited by the opportunity to support our team on our digital creative and elevate our work to the next level.


Websites form a core part of our business therefore a passion for and extensive experience in web design is a must. Our ideal candidate will have a strong visual sense, an analytical mind, a good eye for detail and the portfolio to back it up.


We’re looking for someone who does not shy away from a challenge and is comfortable working to tight deadlines when required. You will be joining us during an exciting time and will be working on multiple projects simultaneously, often for different clients. Our team is entrepreneurial, smart, hard working and fun - Wunderdogs is a challenging yet very rewarding workplace, one where your effort and passion can make a real difference to our clients.


Your key day-to-day responsibilities will include


  • Conceptualizing creative ideas with clients

  • Maintaining the appearance of websites by enforcing content standards
  • Designing visual imagery for websites and ensuring that they are in line with branding for clients.
  • Effectively communicate your designs to developers and other key stakeholders
  • Address product, marketing and business needs
  • Conduct industry research and stay up-to-date on best practices, competitor UI designs and emerging technologies
  • Facilitate web workshops for our clients
  • Create lo-fi wireframes and high-fidelity designs in Figma
  • Develop design systems, design websites using brand guidelines
  • Communicate with clients and attend client meetings
  • Collaborate with developers to design new and intuitive user experiences
  • Interact with our development and management teams to collaborate on pitches and strategies


The Qualifications


  • 4-5 years of design industry experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in graphic design or similar field and a strong portfolio of digital projects
  • Fluent across the Adobe Creative Suite and Figma
  • Understanding of design systems and how to create them
  • Understanding of Figma and how to use it
  • Great communication skills: whether it’s talking through your work with the team or speaking with clients, you’ll need to be able to get your point across and empathize with those of others
  • Experience creating products with complex user flows and high-quality UI design is a plus
  • Experience running stakeholder workshops with clients
  • Ability to work at least 3-4 business hours in Pacific Standard Time
  • Self-motivation in a remote professional environment and ability to work independently as well as part of a team
  • Sharp attention to detail within a fast-paced work environment


The Perks


  • Diverse team and interesting projects from all over the globe

title: Global Feasibility Lead II
description:
Job Overview

The Global Feasibility Lead II will play an integral role in operational strategy and planning in the preaward space through participation in strategy development conversations, robust primary and secondary data collection and analysis, and development of feasibility and site selection strategies. In addition, the Global Feasibility Lead II will be responsible for managing global feasibility projects, working closely with representatives within the company to deliver robust feasibility reports to our customers. The Global Feasibility Lead II will transition the site selection strategy to operations in the post-award space by handing over relevant pre-award findings to the site selection team. The Global Feasibility Lead II will lead and/or contribute to process improvement and change initiatives within Feasibility, alongside training opportunities for departmental requirements and any other subjects that impact on feasibility conduct. The Global Feasibility Lead 2 role requires a diverse skill set; strong data mining and analytics skills, writing and presentation skills, and customer management skills are required. Comfort with participating in and/or leading client facing interactions as it relates to presenting feasibility related findings and recommendations is necessary.


Summary Of Responsibilities

  • Accountable for supporting the development, analyses, interpretation, and presentation of primary and secondary data in support of operational strategy and planning.
  • Conducts data mining of internal and external databases and initiates/oversees the collection of primary data for use in development of robust strategies for global clinical trials (country/site mix, site selection, enrollment modeling.).
  • Participates in the development of proposals and bid defenses; provides recommendations on the most appropriate use of data to support proposals and bid defense presentations, works with the team to identify potential risks, and is learning to propose effective solutions as appropriate.
  • Actively participates on cross-functional teams that plan, analyze, and present proposals and bid defenses as part of winning new business and maintaining client base.
  • Serves as functional bidder reviewer of the budget and text for proposals for which feasibility and/or site identification is included as the primary deliverable.
  • Leads cross functional teams in standalone feasibility efforts; responsible for final report creation and delivery, including discussion of findings and recommendations with external clients.
  • Participates in intra and inter-departmental meetings, leading/contributing to the presentation of information on feasibility offerings, demonstrating continued value-add of the department and providing training on best practices, processes and tools.
  • Develops networking abilities and has an ability/willingness to work with individuals across the globe.
  • Leads and/or contributes to process improvement or special projects within Feasibility.
  • Lead and/or contributes to development, implementation, and maintenance of systems within Feasibility.
  • Contributes to best practice for feasibility conduct.
  • Mentors junior team members (GFL1 or newer GFL2s as needed)
  • And all other duties as needed or assigned.


Qualifications (Minimum Required)

  • Associate degree with equivalent work experience.
  • Practical experience and understanding of global drug development and clinical trials including demonstrated experience for the mining, manipulating, and presenting of complex scientific data as it relates to clinical research and market analyses.


Experience (Minimum Required)

  • Candidates should have at least 4 years of working experience in an academic, science/health-related industry and at least 2 years of relevant experience in clinical research or a science/health-related industry. An associate degree is required; a master’s degree in a science-related discipline is preferred.
  • Position specific requirements:
  • Strong data mining and analytical skills.
  • Strong writing and presentation skills.
  • Upholds the highest standard of personal professionalism and work integrity.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently.
  • Strong attention to detail/quality control skills.
  • Ability to successfully and quickly understand scientific information so as to be able to independently source data/information relevant to a scientific/medical strategy.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with team members, management, operations staff, clients, and executive management.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities effectively.
  • Negotiation and relationship management skills.
  • Experience in analyzing study and investigator performance metrics.
  • Self-motivated, works effectively under pressure.
  • Technical Requirements:
  • Excellent computer skills, including strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and other data capture and compilation tools.
  • Established knowledge of tools used in obtaining critical market analyses of therapeutic pipelines.
  • Strong skills in scientific data manipulation, analysis, reporting, and maintenance.
  • Proven written and verbal communication skills, with strengths in independently gathering/presenting data in support of operational strategy and planning.

  • Excellent critical thinking, pattern recognition, and analytical writing skills.

title: Electrical Supervisor
description:
Offshore Electrical Supervisor - Drillship in Brazil - Local payroll


* Offshore Experience working on a drillship or Semi is essential *


Overview


We are seeking an experienced and proactive Electrical Supervisor to oversee all electrical systems and operations onboard a drillship.

In this role, you will ensure high operational efficiency, compliance with safety standards, and support smooth offshore drilling activities. This role is critical to ensuring the continued success of our offshore operations while fostering an inclusive, safety-first work environment.

This position offers an exciting opportunity to work in a dynamic and diverse offshore environment. Candidates with leadership capabilities, technical expertise, and experience in drilling operations are encouraged to apply.


Responsibilities

  • Supervise the installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of onboard electrical systems, including complex drilling and offshore equipment.
  • Ensure compliance with all safety regulations, electrical codes, and offshore operation standards.
  • Coordinate with the drilling and mechanical teams to ensure seamless integration of electrical systems in daily operations.
  • Develop, review, and update maintenance schedules for electrical equipment and systems.
  • Conduct routine inspections and testing of all electrical systems to identify and address potential hazards or failures.
  • Provide leadership, guidance, and training to a diverse team of electricians and support crew members.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to resolve technical challenges and implement long-term solutions for system efficiency.
  • Maintain accurate records of electrical works, inspections, breakdowns, and necessary upgrades for equipment.
  • Contribute to the safety culture on the drillship by adhering to and promoting a safe work environment, including performing safety audits and toolbox talks.
  • Work within teams to prepare for emergencies and respond promptly to electrical system failures or incidents.


Experience :

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in a supervisor role, preferably on a drillship or semi-submersible
  • Strong understanding of marine electrical systems, offshore drilling equipment, and high-voltage systems.
  • Technical Skills : Proficiency in troubleshooting electrical systems, managing control panels, and handling PLC systems.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of international offshore standards, electrical codes, and safety regulations.
  • Proven ability to lead and work with diverse teams in high-pressure and dynamic environments.
  • Physical fitness to work in an offshore setting, with appropriate certifications (e.g., BOSIET, HUET, or OGUK Medical Certificate).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to ensure effective collaboration across teams.


Day-to-day

  • Inspect, maintain, and repair electrical systems to ensure uninterrupted operations.
  • Oversee electrical team members, assigning tasks and providing technical guidance as needed.
  • Communicate with the drilling and operations team to address any immediate power or system issues affecting performance.
  • Monitor and report electrical maintenance progress to onboard management and onshore support teams.
  • Document all findings during inspections and repairs, updating maintenance logs accordingly.
  • Provide mentorship to less-experienced team members, fostering an inclusive and supportive learning environment.

Good interpersonal skills.

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Sua experiência técnica e sua paixão pela IA serão essenciais para guiar o time na criação de soluções escaláveis e de alto desempenho.



Responsabilidades:


  • Projetar, desenvolver e implementar soluções de software utilizando tecnologias de inteligência artificial.
  • Trabalhar com algoritmos e técnicas específicas de IA, incluindo NLP e aprendizado de máquina.
  • Implementar soluções de IA utilizando linguagens de programação como Python, JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js.
  • Utilizar frameworks de IA, como PyTorch, Scikit-Learn e Langchain, para desenvolver soluções escaláveis.
  • Implementar soluções de NLP com ferramentas como NLTK, spaCy e Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Realizar pré-processamento de texto, incluindo tokenização, criação de embeddings e remoção de stop words.
  • Trabalhar com Modelos de Linguagem de Grande Porte (LLMs), como GPT e Llama, aplicando melhores práticas de arquitetura de software.
  • Desenvolver aplicações web utilizando frameworks como FastAPI e React (NextJS).
  • Colaborar na implementação de soluções utilizando MLOps, Docker e Kubernetes para a implantação de modelos de IA.
  • Participar de processos de HAG (Hiper-Agilidade) para garantir entregas rápidas e eficientes.
  • Integrar e otimizar embeddings para melhorar a performance das soluções de IA.
  • Mentorizar e apoiar os membros da equipe, promovendo um ambiente de aprendizado e colaboração.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência com N8N é obrigatória.
  • Experiência com RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e otimização de embeddings.
  • Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de software para aplicações de inteligência artificial.
  • Proficiência em linguagens de programação: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js ou Go.
  • Experiência com frameworks de IA, como PyTorch, Scikit-Learn e Langchain.
  • Conhecimento em bibliotecas de NLP, como NLTK, spaCy e Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Experiência em pré-processamento de texto e implementação de LLMs.
  • Vivência em arquiteturas de software escaláveis e de alto desempenho voltadas para IA.
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento web com FastAPI e React (NextJS).
  • Experiência com MLOps, Docker e Kubernetes para implantação de modelos de IA.
  • Habilidade de trabalho em equipe e boa comunicação.

Garantir a segurança e conformidade da infraestrutura, incluindo controle de acesso, rede e comunicação entre serviços com Istio

Automatizar a criação e gerenciamento de recursos na AWS com Terraform, Crossplane e Kustomization

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full-Stack Software Engineer (Agents & Rapid Prototyping)

Location: Remote (US-friendly hours) - Central Time Zone

Type: Full-time (founding/early engineer)

Team: Small, passionate, ego-free builders


Why this role

We’re hunting for product–market fit . That means we ship POCs fast, test hypotheses daily, and aren’t afraid to throw work away if the data says so. If you code for fun , ask “why ” before “how ,” and love turning messy problems into scrappy automation that actually saves people time—this is your playground.


So we're on the same page, Vibe-Coding is helpful to very quickly discuss feature requirements and expectations before we commit to a full build.


What you’ll do

  • Prototype at lightning speed: Build and ship POCs, internal tools, and production features in days—not weeks.
  • Work with LLMs & SLMs: Integrate, evaluate, and fine-tune models; design agentic workflows that reduce manual work.
  • Automate the boring stuff: Sniff out bottlenecks, redundancies, and paper cuts; replace them with lightweight automations.
  • Balance build vs. buy: Pragmatically choose off-the-shelf services vs. custom code; optimize for speed, cost, and learning.
  • Own the stack end-to-end: APIs, data models, frontends, deployments, instrumentation, and on-call for what you build.
  • Collaborate without ego: Pair with design, product, and GTM to clarify the “why,” define thin slices, and ship continuously.
  • Ruthlessly iterate: Be comfortable restarting weekly if needed; measure outcomes, not lines of code.


Outcomes (how we’ll measure success)

  • 2–3 prod-quality launches/month from idea → shipped.
  • Clear learning loops : each release produces measurable signal (conversion, retention, time-saved).
  • Automation ROI: hours saved/team/week; decreased cycle time; reduced ops tickets.
  • Agent impact: at least one agent in steady use by internal or pilot users within first 60 days.


You might be a fit if you

  • Have 4+ years building full-stack products (or equivalent portfolio/hacker track record).
  • Are fluent in a modern web stack (e.g., TypeScript/Node , Python , React/Next ; Postgres/Redis; REST/GraphQL).
  • Have shipped LLM/SLM features (tool use, RAG, function calling, evals, latency/cost tuning).
  • Can design simple, resilient backends; write clean, testable code; and deploy via CI/CD to a major cloud.
  • Love debugging with data : logs, traces, metrics; you instrument before you guess.
  • Communicate crisply, ask sharp questions, and default to action.
  • Thrive in ambiguity; you don’t need a JIRA novella to start building.


Nice to have

  • Vector DBs, embeddings, prompt/version management, offline evals.
  • Agent frameworks (e.g., OpenAI tools, LangGraph, custom planners/executors).
  • Queueing/event systems (e.g., Kafka, SQS), WebSockets, streaming.
  • Security and privacy basics (authn/z, secrets, PII handling).
  • Experience with low-cost scrappy stacks (Cloudflare, Fly.io, Supabase, Firebase).


Our stack (evolving)

  • FE: React/Next.js, Tailwind, tRPC/GraphQL
  • BE: Node/TypeScript and/or Python FastAPI
  • Data: Postgres, Redis/Upstash, optional vector store
  • Infra: Vercel/Fly.io/Cloudflare + Docker; CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
  • AI: OpenAI, Anthropic, local SLMs when useful; evaluation harness + prompt/version control


How we work

  • Learn > Perfect: Ship thin slices, get signal, iterate.
  • Write it down: Short RFCs → prototype → user feedback within days.
  • Builder culture: No rockstars, no heroes—just ownership and curiosity.
  • Time-zone friendly: Async first; quick huddles when needed.


Interview flow

  • Intro chat (30 min): goals, mindset, what great looks like.
  • Builder exercise (home or live, 2–4 hrs): ship a tiny agent or automation; explain trade-offs.
  • Technical deep dive (60 min): architecture, data modeling, reliability, AI evals/cost.
  • Team fit (30 min): collaboration, feedback loops, “why before what.”


Compensation

Competitive salary + meaningful equity. We optimize for ownership and impact .

title: Application Project Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for Application Project Manager who wants to learn and transform his career.


Job Description:

The Application Project Manager will drive the delivery and management of IT applications throughout their lifecycle. This role is essential to ensure the effectiveness, security and innovation of the applications, contributing to the overall technological advancement and operational efficiency of the organization. The professional must possess a distinct combination of business, IT, financial, and communication skills.


Main Responsibilities:

  • Project Management: Developing detailed project plans, including timelines, milestones, and deliverables. Ensure the timely and successful delivery of IT projects, meeting defined goals and expectations.
  • Leadership and People Management: Lead and inspire project teams, promoting a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. Provide support, guidance, and mentorship to team members, encouraging their professional growth.
  • Stakeholder Management: Developing and maintaining strong relationships with all project stakeholders, ensuring that their needs and expectations are understood and managed effectively.
  • Resource Management and Budget: Allocate and manage resources effectively to ensure project delivery within scope, deadline, and budget constraints. Develop and manage the project budget, seeking to optimize expenses and minimize the total cost of ownership.
  • Supplier and Contract Management: Collaborate and negotiate with suppliers, ensuring adherence to contractual obligations and service level agreements (SLAs).
  • Risk Management: Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks to ensure successful completion.
  • Quality Assurance and Compliance: Implement rigorous testing and quality assurance protocols. Ensure that all project activities comply with relevant laws, regulations, and organizational policies.


Essential Requirements (Hard Skills):

  • Experience: Minimum of 11 to 15 years of experience. More than 10 years of experience in IT project management with a focus on application development and deployment.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.
  • Tools: Proficiency in project management software such as MS Project, Jira, Trello . Knowledge of reporting and analysis tools to track metrics and project performance.
  • Methodologies: Familiarity with project management methodologies such as PMI, PRINCE2 and Agile approaches.

Soft Skills:

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Leadership: Strong leadership qualities to guide and motivate teams.
  • Conflict Resolution: Proficiency in identifying and resolving conflicts through effective mediation and negotiation techniques.
  • Negotiation Skill and Influence: Effective negotiation skills for dealing with contracts. Ability to influence in an environment where paper does not directly control resources.
  • Adaptation: Ability to adapt to new circumstances in a changing business environment.
  • Customer Focus: A customer-centric approach to understanding and meeting needs effectively.
  • Languages: English and/or French are considered an asset.


Expected Skills:

  • Lead and motivate teams, demonstrating empathy.
  • Maintain a high level of expertise in IT applications and systems.
  • Oversee the integration of various IT applications to ensure operation and security.
  • Evaluate and recommend technical solutions that align with business needs.
  • Establish and manage customer expectations.
  • Develop and execute a resource plan to ensure that the right people are in the right place, doing the right things at the right time.


Differentials (Nice to Have):

  • Certifications: PMP (Project Management Professional) certification or equivalent. Scrum Master certification or equivalent Agile certification.
  • Education: Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Knowledge: Strong knowledge of ITIL practices. Knowledge of current and emerging technologies.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop custom WordPress plugins and themes from scratch using PHP, MySQL, and modern best practices.
  • Implement advanced custom fields (ACF) , custom post types , and taxonomies for structured data management.
  • Optimize database queries and improve performance across complex WordPress sites (meta queries, caching, indexing).
  • Integrate WordPress with third-party APIs and automation tools (REST, webhook systems, Make/Zapier, Algolia, etc.).
  • Develop and maintain cron jobs , background tasks, and data synchronization scripts.
  • Build and maintain Gutenberg blocks or React-based admin components when required.
  • Ensure sites meet performance, accessibility, and SEO standards (Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (frontend, DevOps, QA, design) following Agile practices.
  • Write clean, well-documented, and unit-tested code following OOP principles and WordPress coding standards.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience , focusing on backend and custom plugin work.
  • Strong proficiency in PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript .
  • Experience with WordPress hooks (actions & filters) , custom queries, and optimization strategies.
  • Proficient in ACF , CPT UI , Gutenberg , and WooCommerce .
  • Solid understanding of WordPress REST API , webhooks , and API integrations .
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines .
  • Experience with performance optimization , caching mechanisms, and scalable WordPress architectures.
  • Advanced written and spoken English (international client communication required).


Benefits

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Staff Accountant (Netsuite)
description:
SUMMARY


INTUS Windows is seeking a detail-oriented and systems-savvy NetSuite Accountant to manage the entry, accuracy, and validation of accounting data within our NetSuite ERP platform. This role plays a key part in supporting Finance and Accounting operations by ensuring clean, consistent, and well-tested financial data across all core accounting modules — including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), General Ledger (GL), and Payroll.

The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in accounting, hands-on experience with NetSuite, and enjoys working in a structured, process-driven environment. This position is responsible for data entry, testing, reconciliations, and configuration validation within the NetSuite system.


PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES


NetSuite Accounting Data Management


  • Enter and validate accounting-related data in NetSuite.
  • Ensure completeness and accuracy of all accounting entries in NetSuite across AR, AP, GL, and Payroll modules.
  • Conduct regular audits to identify and correct data inconsistencies or configuration issues.
  • Support daily transactional entry, adjustments, and posting of journal entries under supervision.


Testing & System Validation


  • Assist in testing accounting processes across NetSuite modules:
  • Validate system workflows for AP, AR, GL, Fixed Assets, and Payroll.
  • Perform UAT (User Acceptance Testing) during NetSuite updates or enhancements.
  • Work closely with the Accounting, Finance, and IT teams to identify and troubleshoot accounting-related system errors or configuration gaps.
  • Help document testing procedures and results for audit and compliance purposes.


Month-End & Operational Support


  • Support the month-end close process by preparing, verifying, and entering journal entries in NetSuite.
  • Assist in reconciling general ledger accounts and running reports to support financial review.
  • Ensure system data is closed and locked appropriately in accordance with internal deadlines.


Documentation & Internal Support


  • Maintain accurate documentation of system processes, data input standards, and workflows within NetSuite.
  • Assist accounting team members in navigating NetSuite functionality and resolving data entry issues.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of NetSuite accounting procedures and controls.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.


KEY COMPETENCIES


  • Strong working knowledge of NetSuite ERP and accounting module navigation.
  • Understanding of US GAAP accounting principles.
  • Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative accounting team.
  • Capable of managing multiple tasks in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting data manipulation.
  • Effective communication and organizational skills.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE


  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 2–5 years of accounting experience, with 2+ years of hands-on strong experience in NetSuite ERP.
  • Solid understanding of general accounting functions including journal entries, reconciliations, and month-end processes.
  • Experience working with accounting data across modules like AR, AP, GL, and Payroll.


WHAT WE OFFER


  • Remote work opportunity.
  • Working hours 8-5 EST (preferred).
  • Monthly gross salary within the range of $1000-$2200.
  • Participating in our "One Window - One Tree" initiative.
  • The opportunity to improve your skills through professional development training.
  • A rapidly growing company.
  • A collaborative and supportive team environment.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados Júnior
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Sobre a Engenharia de Dados:

Somos a área responsável pela coleta, tratamento, organização e disponibilização dos dados nas soluções e API da Neoway, bem como manter a sustentação desses dados. Nossos times estão organizados de acordo com o contexto de negócio de cada pacote de dados que sustentamos. Estes times são compostos por uma coordenação técnica, responsável por fazer a ponte entre os times de dados e o time de negócio, e pessoas Engenheiras de Dados, responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento e configuração de todas as etapas do fluxo da operação e produção de dados.


#Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Dentre as principais funções do papel estão:

  • Desenvolvimento de web crawling para coleta de dados;
  • Monitoramento dos serviços de produção;
  • Evolução e manutenção de serviços de coleta, tratamento e agregação;


#Requisitos e qualificações:

Para desenvolver tudo isso contamos que você possua/ou esteja a fim de aprender os conhecimentos abaixo:

  • Desenvolvimento web crawling;
  • Linguagem de programação Python;
  • MongoDB, Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQL;
  • Parser de HTML, JSON, PDF, entre outros;


Seguimos práticas básicas de desenvolvimento:

  • Testes unitários, integração, e em alguns casos, sistema.
  • Projeto de infraestrutura como código.
  • Usamos CI do gitlab, para automatizar a maior parte de rotinas (testes, release).
  • Nos preocupamos com um código limpo e bem estruturado.
  • Fazemos Code Review. Nenhuma mudança vai para a operação sem o time aprovar. Seja via thumbs up do Gitlab ou durante uma discussão da daily.
  • Todo desenvolvimento de uma nova fonte é baseado em especificações que são escritas pela nossa pessoa Data Owner. Nela temos as definições de inputs e outputs, regras de negócio e resultados esperados. A especificação técnica fica sob responsabilidade do desenvolvedor que tem total abertura para decidir a melhor forma de desenvolvimento em conjunto com os demais colegas de time.
